thesis: The episode discusses the book 'Seeking Virtue in Finance' by J.C. de Swaan, which explores how finance professionals can pursue viable careers while benefiting society and upholding humanistic values despite industry pressures. The author defines virtue as the ability to balance self-interest with the collective interest and emphasizes studying role models who are self-interested, ambitious, and successful rather than purely altruistic.
